title: 欧洲央行行长谈证券次日结算与代币化
title_en: ECB Executive on T+1 Settlement and Tokenization
summary: 欧洲央行执行委员会成员皮耶罗·奇波隆发表讲话，探讨次日证券结算、资产代币化及其对欧洲金融基础设施转型的影响，属政策前瞻阐述，非新规或行动决定。
summary_en: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone discussed T+1 securities settlement, asset tokenization, and their implications for transforming Europe's financial infrastructure—presented as forward-looking policy analysis, not a new rule or decision.
sourceName: ECB 欧洲央行

title: 香港证监会批准首只代币化公募基金二级交易
title_en: HK SFC Approves First Tokenized Mutual Fund for Secondary Trading
summary: 香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（SFC）批准首只代币化公募基金在获认可平台开展二级市场交易，属SFC首次就此类产品作出批准。
summary_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong has approved the first tokenized mutual fund for secondary market trading on a recognized platform—the SFC’s inaugural approval for such products.
sourceName: SFC 香港证监会

title: 货币监理署就GENIUS法案下稳定币发行业务许可申请信息收集征询意见
title_en: OCC Seeks Comment on Information Collection for GENIUS Stablecoin Licensing
summary: 货币监理署（OCC）依据《1995年文书削减法》，就GENIUS法案下支付稳定币发行许可或注册申请所需新信息收集工作征询公众意见。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) seeks public comment under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 on new information collection requirements for applications seeking stablecoin issuance licenses or registration under the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国货币监理署发布稳定币发行监管新规
title_en: OCC Issues New Stablecoin Issuance Regulations
summary: 美国货币监理署（OCC）发布新规，落实《美国稳定币指南与国家创新法案》，规范其监管范围内实体发行支付型稳定币及相关活动。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) issued new rules implementing the U.S. Stablecoin Guidance and National Innovation Act, regulating payment stablecoin issuance and related activities by entities under its supervision.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国货币监理署就稳定币发行人报告表征询公众意见
title_en: OCC Seeks Public Input on Stablecoin Issuer Reporting Form
summary: 美国货币监理署依据《1995年文书削减法》就新设的许可支付型稳定币发行人报告表格及说明启动公众意见征询，以减轻行政负担。
summary_en: Pursuant to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, the OCC is soliciting public comments on a newly proposed reporting form and instructions for licensed payment stablecoin issuers to reduce administrative burdens.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国货币监理署发布最终规则落实GENIUS稳定币法案
title_en: OCC Issues Final Rule Implementing the GENIUS Stablecoin Act
summary: 美国货币监理署（OCC）发布最终规则，落实《引导与确立美国稳定币国家创新法案》（GENIUS法案），旨在推进美国数字资产领域领导地位。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) issued a final rule implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation in United States Stablecoins (GENIUS) Act to advance U.S. leadership in digital assets.
sourceName: OCC 美国货币监理署

title: 美国商品期货交易委员会就加密资产交易规则征询意见
title_en: CFTC Proposes Rules for Crypto Asset Trading
summary: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）发布高级拟议规则制定通知，就《商品交易法》第2(c)(2)(D)条下加密资产交易及市场规则制定征求公众意见。
summary_en: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) issued an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking seeking public input on rules governing crypto asset trading and markets under Section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港证监会发布反洗钱及反恐融资监管通告
title_en: SFC Issues AML/CFT Regulatory Notice
summary: 香港证监会向持牌法团、虚拟资产服务提供商及相关实体发布反洗钱/反恐融资通告，并举办专题网络研讨会。
summary_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong issued an anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing notice to licensed corporations, virtual asset service providers, and related entities, and hosted a dedicated webinar.
sourceName: SFC 通函

title: 金融稳定理事会主席发布AI与稳定币监管工作进展
title_en: FSB Chair Releases Progress on AI and Stablecoin Regulation
summary: 金融稳定理事会（FSB）主席安德鲁·贝利发布说明，阐述FSB对全球稳定币脆弱性的监测进展，并公布关于人工智能采用的最终审慎实践指南。
summary_en: FSB Chair Andrew Bailey outlined progress in monitoring global stablecoin vulnerabilities and published the final guidance on prudent practices for AI adoption.
sourceName: FSB 金融稳定理事会

title: 国家信用合作社管理局就稳定币相关数据纳入信用社季报征询意见
title_en: NCUA Proposes Adding Stablecoin Data to Credit Union Quarterly Reports
summary: 国家信用合作社管理局（NCUA）就修订《NCUA季报》（表5300）征询意见，拟新增采集信用合作社参与支付稳定币活动的相关数据。
summary_en: The National Credit Union Administration (NCUA) seeks public comment on revising Form 5300 (NCUA Quarterly Report) to collect new data on credit unions’ participation in payment stablecoin activities.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国财政部就数字资产信息共享标准表征询公众意见
title_en: U.S. Treasury Seeks Public Input on Digital Asset Data Standards
summary: 美国财政部依据《1995年文书削减法》，就“数字资产信息共享倡议：数字资产标准表”拟议信息收集事项公开征求意见，旨在减少行政负担和受访者负担。
summary_en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury is soliciting public comments on its proposed 'Digital Asset Information Sharing Initiative: Digital Asset Standard Form' under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, aiming to reduce administrative and respondent burdens.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国SEC发布加密资产投资合同发行新规
title_en: SEC Proposes New Rules for Crypto Asset Investment Contracts
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提议制定新规则，为涉及加密资产的特定投资合同建立定制化发行制度，旨在促进资本形成并支持加密市场创新。
summary_en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) proposes tailored issuance rules for certain investment contracts involving crypto assets to foster capital formation and support innovation in crypto markets.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国FinCEN撤回虚拟货币交易监管提案
title_en: FinCEN Withdraws Proposed Virtual Currency Transaction Rule
summary: 美国金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）撤回此前关于要求银行及货币服务企业就可转换虚拟货币（CVC）或数字资产交易履行报告、记录保存和客户身份验证义务的拟议规则制定通知（NPRM）。
summary_en: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) withdraws its prior Notice of Proposed Rulemaking requiring banks and money services businesses to report, retain records, and verify customer identities for convertible virtual currency (CVC) or digital asset transactions.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国SEC就加密资产托管规则征求意见
title_en: SEC Proposes Crypto Asset Custody Rules
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提出新规及修订草案，为注册投资顾问和受监管基金（如注册投资公司） custody 加密资产提供专门框架，以符合联邦证券法要求。
summary_en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed new rules and amendments to establish a dedicated custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds (e.g., registered investment companies) holding crypto assets, ensuring compliance with federal securities laws.
sourceName: SEC 美国证监会

title: 美财政部发布稳定币认证审查临时程序规则
title_en: U.S. Treasury Issues Interim Rule for Stablecoin Certification Review
summary: 美国财政部代表稳定币认证审查委员会发布临时最终规则，确立州级稳定币认证的审查表单与程序，以落实《GENIUS法案》第4(c)条授权职责。
summary_en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury, acting on behalf of the Stablecoin Certification Review Board, issues an interim final rule establishing review forms and procedures for state-level stablecoin certification, implementing Section 4(c) of the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港金管局IP融资沙盒完成首批试点信贷审批
title_en: HKMA IP Financing Sandbox Completes First Credit Approvals
summary: 香港金融管理局主导的知识产权融资沙盒计划中，参与银行已完成首批试点项目的信贷审批工作。
summary_en: Banks participating in the HKMA's Intellectual Property Financing Sandbox have completed credit approvals for the first pilot projects.
sourceName: HKMA 香港金管局

title: 美联储就银行子公司发行支付型稳定币征询意见
title_en: Fed Seeks Comment on Bank Subsidiaries Issuing Payment Stablecoins
summary: 美联储理事会提议制定规章，明确受其监管的投保州成员银行申请批准其子公司依据《GENIUS法案》发行支付型稳定币所需遵循的程序。
summary_en: The Federal Reserve Board proposes a rule clarifying the approval process for insured state member banks seeking authorization for their subsidiaries to issue payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美联储就实施GENIUS法案提出监管规则草案
title_en: Federal Reserve Proposes GENIUS Act Implementation Rules
summary: 美联储理事会提议制定规章，落实《GENIUS法案》关于美联储监管范围内许可支付型稳定币发行人（PPSI）及其他相关实体的法定职责。
summary_en: The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules to implement statutory responsibilities under the GENIUS Act regarding supervision of permitted payment stablecoin issuers (PPSIs) and related entities within its regulatory purview.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美联储就GENIUS法案下支付型稳定币发行人监管框架征询意见
title_en: Fed Solicits Comments on Regulatory Framework for Payment Stablecoin Issuers
summary: 美联储就两项提案公开征求意见，拟建立由美联储监管的支付型稳定币发行人监管框架，相关工作依据《GENIUS法案》展开。
summary_en: The Federal Reserve is seeking public comment on two proposals to establish a supervisory framework for payment stablecoin issuers under its authority, as directed by the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: Federal Reserve 美联储

title: 美国SEC授予分布式账本交易场所临时豁免
title_en: SEC Grants Temporary Exemption to DLT Trading Venues
summary: 美国SEC依据《1934年证券交易法》第36(a)(1)条，授予特定分布式账本交易平台就代币化全国市场系统股票交易临时有条件豁免，豁免其适用“交易所”及部分流动性提供者适用“交易商”定义，并同步征求公众意见。
summary_en: The SEC grants conditional, temporary exemptions under Section 36(a)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to certain distributed ledger trading platforms for tokenized NMS stock trading—exempting them from the 'exchange' definition and certain liquidity providers from the 'dealer' definition—while soliciting public comment.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国SEC就代币化NMS股票交易发布创新豁免并征求意见
title_en: SEC Grants Innovation Exemption for Tokenized NMS Stock Trading
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）发布“创新豁免”，允许在链上交易特定代币化全国市场系统股票，并同步就该豁免措施公开征求意见。
summary_en: The U.S. SEC issued an 'Innovation Exemption' permitting on-chain trading of certain tokenized National Market System stocks and opened it for public comment.
sourceName: SEC 美国证监会

title: 香港证监会发布持牌机构及虚拟资产服务商通告
title_en: SFC Issues Circular to Licensed Firms and VASPs
summary: 香港证监会向持牌法团、SFC持牌虚拟资产服务提供商及相关实体发布 circular，内容涉及经纪商论坛相关事项及监管要求提醒。
summary_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issued a circular to licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers, and related entities, covering matters from the broker forum and reminders on regulatory compliance requirements.
sourceName: SFC 通函

title: 英国金融行为监管局启动GenA.I. Sandbox++首批试点
title_en: UK FCA Launches First GenAI Sandbox++ Pilots
summary: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）宣布启动GenA.I. Sandbox++计划的首批试点，旨在支持生成式人工智能在金融领域的安全创新应用。
summary_en: The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has launched the first pilot phase of its GenA.I. Sandbox++ initiative to foster safe, innovative applications of generative AI in financial services.
sourceName: HKMA 香港金管局

title: 美国SEC提议加密资产证券发行专门规则
title_en: SEC Proposes Special Rules for Crypto Asset Securities Offerings
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提议制定新规则，为涉及加密资产的特定投资合同建立专门发行框架，以在保障投资者保护前提下促进资本形成与市场创新。
summary_en: The SEC proposes new rules establishing a dedicated framework for offerings of securities involving crypto assets, balancing investor protection with capital formation and market innovation.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美财政部就GENIUS法案稳定币发行销售规则征求意见
title_en: Treasury Seeks Input on GENIUS Act Stablecoin Issuance Rules
summary: 美国财政部就落实《GENIUS法案》第3条关于支付型稳定币在美国的发行、要约与销售之法定禁令与限制，提出监管规则制定草案并公开征求意见。
summary_en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury proposes a rulemaking to implement statutory prohibitions and restrictions under Section 3 of the GENIUS Act concerning the issuance, offer, and sale of payment stablecoins in the United States, and invites public comment.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 货币监理署就GENIUS法案下稳定币发行业务许可申请信息收集续期征询意见
title_en: OCC Seeks Comment on Extension of GENIUS Stablecoin Information Collection
summary: 货币监理署（OCC）依据《1995年文书削减法》，就GENIUS法案下支付稳定币发行许可或注册申请所需信息收集工作的延续征询公众意见。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) seeks public comment under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 on extending the information collection for stablecoin issuance license or registration applications under the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: MEMX交易所获美证监会加速批准加密资产多币种信托期权上市规则修订
title_en: SEC Accelerates Approval of MEMX’s Crypto-Linked Multi-Asset Trust Options Listing Rules
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）加速批准MEMX LLC提交的规则修订（经部分修正案1修改），修订规则19.3和19.4，确立含多种加密资产的商品型信托期权的上市标准及退市标准。
summary_en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) granted accelerated approval to MEMX LLC’s amended rule filings (as modified by Amendment No. 1), revising Rules 19.3 and 19.4 to establish listing and delisting standards for commodity trust options linked to multiple crypto assets.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: FDIC就受保存款机构稳定币发行人报告表格及说明征询意见
title_en: FDIC Seeks Comment on New Reporting Form for Insured Stablecoin Issuers
summary: FDIC就与“受保存款机构许可支付稳定币发行人”新规配套的新报告表格及填写说明征询公众意见，该材料关联OMB控制编号3064-0225。
summary_en: The FDIC seeks public comment on a new reporting form and instructions for insured depository institutions licensed as payment stablecoin issuers, associated with OMB Control Number 3064-0225.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: OCC联合FinCEN等机构拟订稳定币反洗钱合规规则
title_en: OCC, FinCEN, and OFAC Jointly Propose AML/CFT Rules for Stablecoins
summary: 美国货币监理署（OCC）协同FinCEN与OFAC，提议制定规则，落实《GENIUS法案》对许可支付型稳定币发行人提出的反洗钱/反恐融资及制裁合规风险管理要求。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), in coordination with FinCEN and OFAC, proposes rules to implement anti-money laundering/counter-terrorist financing and sanctions compliance risk management requirements for permitted payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国SEC批准24X交易所开展代币化证券交易试点
title_en: SEC Approves 24X Exchange Tokenized Securities Pilot
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）批准24X国家交易所提交的规则修改，允许其在存管信托公司（DTC）运营的试点计划期间交易代币化证券。该规则修改即日生效。
summary_en: The U.S. SEC approved rule changes by 24X National Exchange to permit tokenized securities trading during a pilot program operated by the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The amendment takes effect immediately.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 多监管机构联合发布稳定币客户身份识别程序规则
title_en: Multi-Agency Rule on Customer Identification for Stablecoin Issuers
summary: FinCEN联合OCC、美联储、FDIC及NCUA共同发布规则，就许可支付型稳定币发行人实施客户身份识别计划（CIP）制定具体要求。
summary_en: FinCEN, jointly with the OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC, and NCUA, issues a rule specifying requirements for permitted payment stablecoin issuers to implement Customer Identification Programs (CIP).
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: OCC就支付稳定币发行人报告要求征求意见
title_en: OCC Seeks Public Input on Stablecoin Issuer Reporting Requirements
summary: 美国货币监理署（OCC）依据《1995年文书削减法》，就面向其监管范围内获许可支付稳定币发行人的新报告表格及说明，公开征求公众意见。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) is soliciting public comments on a new reporting form and instructions for licensed payment stablecoin issuers under its supervision, pursuant to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港金管局推动首笔120亿港元数字债券发行
title_en: HKMA Facilitates Hong Kong's First HK$12B Digital Bond Issuance
summary: 香港金融管理局支持香港按揭证券公司完成120亿港元公开数字债券首次发行，属香港市场首笔同类公募债券。
summary_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority supported Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation in completing its inaugural HK$12 billion public digital bond issuance—the first of its kind in Hong Kong's market.
sourceName: HKMA 香港金管局

title: 香港金管局向企业财资界展示代币化潜力
title_en: HKMA Showcases Tokenized Bonds' Benefits to Corporate Treasurers
summary: 香港金融管理局向企业财资管理人员介绍债券代币化在提升结算效率、降低操作风险等方面的潜在应用价值。
summary_en: The HKMA introduced corporate treasury professionals to the potential benefits of bond tokenization, including enhanced settlement efficiency and reduced operational risk.
sourceName: HKMA 香港金管局

title: MEMX拟修改期权上市规则以覆盖多加密资产信托
title_en: MEMX Proposes Rule Amendments for Multi-Crypto Asset Trust Options
summary: 自律组织MEMX LLC提交规则修改提案，拟修订规则19.3和19.4，为持有多种加密资产的商品型信托所发行期权设立上市标准与退市标准。
summary_en: Self-regulatory organization MEMX LLC has submitted a rule change proposal to amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4, establishing listing and delisting standards for options issued by commodity trusts holding multiple crypto assets.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: FDIC就稳定币发行人反洗钱与制裁合规标准征求意见

summary: 美国联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）依据《GENIUS法案》，就适用于其监管的获许可支付稳定币发行人的《银行保密法》及制裁合规标准，提出监管规则草案并征求意见。
summary_en: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) has issued a proposed rule seeking public comment on Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions compliance standards applicable to licensed payment stablecoin issuers under its supervision, pursuant to the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港金管局成立代币化债券专家小组
title_en: HKMA Establishes Expert Panel on Tokenized Bonds
summary: 香港金融管理局宣布成立代币化债券专家小组，成员涵盖业界机构及技术专家，旨在推动代币化债券生态发展并提供专业建议。
summary_en: The HKMA announced the formation of an expert panel on tokenized bonds, comprising industry practitioners and technology specialists, to advance the ecosystem and provide professional guidance.
sourceName: HKMA 香港金管局

title: 新加坡金管局发布《资本市场产品代币化指引》（取代《数字代币发行指引》）
title_en: MAS publishes Guide on the Tokenisation of Capital Markets Products
summary: 新加坡金融管理局将 2017 年首次发布、2020 年更新的《数字代币发行指引》重新发布为《资本市场产品代币化指引》。指引阐明《2001 年证券与期货法》《2001 年财务顾问法》及相关附属法规对两类事项的适用：一是代币化资本市场产品（tokenised CMPs）的发行与发售；二是为该类产品相关活动（包括二级市场交易、结算与托管）提供便利的机构。指引延续技术中立原则，按经济实质判断监管要求的适用；并说明该指引不取代或凌驾任何法例条文。
summary_en: MAS re-issued its Guide on Digital Token Offerings (first published in 2017, updated in 2020) as the Guide on the Tokenisation of Capital Markets Products. The Guide sets out the application of the Securities and Futures Act 2001, the Financial Advisers Act 2001 and related subsidiary legislation to (i) issuances and offerings of tokenised capital markets products (tokenised CMPs); and (ii) entities facilitating activities in relation to such products, including secondary trading, settlement and custody. It retains a technology-neutral, substance-over-form approach and states that it does not replace or override any legislative provisions.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网（PDF）

title: 新加坡金管局宣布将试点发行代币化金管局票据并为稳定币立法
title_en: MAS announces pilot issuance of tokenised MAS Bills and stablecoin legislation
summary: 新加坡金融管理局局长在新加坡金融科技节主题演讲中宣布：金管局将于 2026 年试点向一级交易商发行代币化金管局票据（tokenised MAS bills），并以央行数码货币（CBDC）进行结算，细节稍后公布；同时将就稳定币制定相关法规。金管局表示三家本地银行（DBS、OCBC、UOB）已利用首次试点发行的新元批发型 CBDC 完成银行间隔夜借贷交易，并将在 BLOOM 倡议下继续支持业界以代币化负债与受监管稳定币进行结算；金管局亦发布 GL1 市场基建工具包（108 项管控，对标《金融市场基建原则》与数字资产证券管控原则）。
summary_en: In his keynote at the Singapore FinTech Festival, MAS Managing Director announced that MAS will trial issuing tokenised MAS Bills to primary dealers from 2026, settled using central bank digital currency, with details to follow, and will draft legislation for stablecoins. MAS noted that DBS, OCBC and UOB have completed interbank overnight lending transactions using the first pilot issuance of wholesale SGD CBDC, and will continue supporting industry trials of settlement with tokenised liabilities and regulated stablecoins under BLOOM. MAS also launched the GL1 Market Infrastructure Toolkit, comprising 108 controls aligned with the Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures and the Digital Asset Securities Control Principles.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网（演讲辞）

title: 金管局推出 Ensemble TX，Ensemble 项目进入试行阶段（真实价值代币化交易）
title_en: HKMA launches Ensemble TX: Project Ensemble moves into pilot phase with real-value transactions
summary: 金管局宣布推出 Ensemble TX，Ensemble 项目正式进入试行阶段，标志着代币化存款及数码资产在可控试行环境中进行真实交易。Ensemble TX 建基于 2024 年 8 月启动的沙盒试验成果；初期聚焦于推动市场参与者在代币化货币市场基金交易中使用代币化存款，以即时管理流动性与资金需求。Ensemble TX 将于 2026 年持续运行，代币化存款交易的跨行结算将首先透过港元即时支付结算系统（RTGS）进行，试行环境将逐步升级至支持代币化央行货币 24/7 全天候结算。金管局将继续与证监会及 Ensemble 项目架构工作小组合作。
summary_en: The HKMA announced the launch of Ensemble TX, marking the start of the pilot phase of Project Ensemble — a key step towards conducting real-value transactions involving tokenised deposits and digital assets in a controlled environment. Building on the Ensemble Sandbox launched in August 2024, Ensemble TX will initially focus on using tokenised deposits for transactions in tokenised money market funds to meet liquidity and funding needs in real time. It will continue running through 2026. Interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions will initially be conducted via the Hong Kong dollar RTGS system, with the environment progressively upgraded to support 24/7 settlement in tokenised central bank money.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

summary_en: The SFC advanced Pillars A (Access) and P (Products) of its ASPIRe roadmap: licensed VATPs may share an order book with affiliated overseas platforms and may distribute tokenised securities and digital asset-related products.

summary_en: The SFC expanded what licensed VATPs may offer: removing the 12-month track-record requirement for professional investors, clarifying distribution of tokenised securities and digital asset-related products, and updating custody requirements. HKMA-licensed stablecoins are exempt from the track-record rule for retail.

title: 新加坡金管局推出 BLOOM 倡议，推动代币化银行负债与受监管稳定币结算
title_en: MAS launches BLOOM to extend settlement capabilities with tokenised bank liabilities and regulated stablecoins
summary: 新加坡金融管理局推出 BLOOM（Borderless, Liquid, Open, Online, Multi-currency）倡议，与业界合作实现以代币化银行负债及受良好监管的稳定币进行结算。BLOOM 建基于 2021 年启动的 Project Orchid，涵盖三方面：多币种（G10 及亚洲货币）、境内与跨境支付结算、批发场景（企业资金管理、贸易融资、代理式支付）。初期重点工作包括结算资产的分销与清算、以标准化机制强化并自动化合规检查、以及代理式支付。初期成员包括 Circle、Coinbase、DBS、OCBC、UOB、Partior、Stripe、Ant International 及 StraitsX 等。
summary_en: MAS announced BLOOM (Borderless, Liquid, Open, Online, Multi-currency), an initiative to work with the industry to enable settlement in tokenised bank liabilities and well-regulated stablecoins while managing risks through standardised approaches. Building on Project Orchid (established 2021), BLOOM covers multiple currencies (G10 and Asian currencies), domestic and cross-border payments and settlement, and wholesale use cases (corporate treasury management, trade finance, agentic payments). Initial focus areas include distribution and clearing of settlement assets, programmable controls to automate compliance checks, and agentic payments.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网

title: 欧盟三大监管局（EBA / EIOPA / ESMA）联合警示：加密资产风险高，消费者保护视产品类型而定可能有限
title_en: Joint ESA warning: crypto-assets carry high risk and consumer protection may be limited depending on the product
summary: EBA、EIOPA 与 ESMA 联合发布消费者警示，提醒加密资产可能具有高风险，且视所投资加密资产的类型，法律保护（如有）可能有限。警示随附一份说明 MiCA 对消费者意味着什么的事实清单。自 2024 年 12 月起，MiCA 适用于特定类型的加密资产，并为欧盟范围内的加密资产发行人与加密资产服务提供商建立一致的监管制度，但并非所有加密资产都受其监管。监管局建议消费者：了解产品与服务并在投资前评估风险；确认加密资产服务提供商已在欧盟获授权；确保用于存储加密资产的钱包足够安全。警示并说明部分成员国存在过渡期安排——2024 年 12 月 30 日前已依据本国法提供服务的机构，可继续依本国法营运至 2026 年 7 月 1 日，或至其 MiCA 授权获批或被拒为止（以较早者为准）；在过渡期内，消费者使用该等服务不享有 MiCA 提供的保护。
summary_en: The EBA, EIOPA and ESMA (the ESAs) issued a joint consumer warning that crypto-assets can be risky and that legal protection, if any, may be limited depending on which crypto-assets are invested in, accompanied by a factsheet on what MiCA means for consumers. Since December 2024, MiCA applies to certain types of crypto-assets and establishes a consistent supervisory regime at national and European level for issuers and crypto-asset service providers across the EU, although not all crypto-assets are regulated. The ESAs recommend that consumers learn about the product or service and evaluate the risk before investing, check that the crypto-asset service provider is authorised in the EU, and make sure any wallets used are sufficiently secured. The warning also notes that a transitional period may apply in some Member States: firms that already provided crypto-asset services under national law before 30 December 2024 may continue under national law until 1 July 2026, or until they are granted or refused authorisation under MiCA, whichever is sooner — during which consumers do not benefit from MiCA protections.

summary: 美国总统签署 S.1582《Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act》（GENIUS Act），建立美国首个联邦支付型稳定币监管制度：要求以美元或短期国债等高流动性资产 100% 储备支持、发行人须每月公开披露储备构成、受《银行保密法》约束并须具备依法冻结与销毁稳定币的技术能力；发行人破产时稳定币持有人债权优先于其他债权人；并统一州与联邦的稳定币监管框架。
summary_en: The President signed S.1582, the GENIUS Act, creating the first federal regulatory regime for payment stablecoins: 100% liquid reserve backing, monthly public reserve disclosures, Bank Secrecy Act obligations, seizure/freeze/burn capability, and priority for stablecoin holders in insolvency.

title: 香港特区政府发表《数字资产发展政策宣言 2.0》，提出 LEAP 框架
title_en: Hong Kong issues Policy Statement 2.0 on Development of Digital Assets with the LEAP framework
summary: 香港特区政府发表《数字资产发展政策宣言 2.0》，提出「LEAP」框架：一、优化法律与监管——正构建涵盖数字资产交易平台、稳定币发行人、数字资产交易服务提供者及数字资产托管服务提供者的统一监管框架，证监会为后两类发牌机制的主要监管机构；财经事务及库务局与金管局牵头就现实世界资产（RWA）及金融工具代币化进行全面法例检讨，检视代币化债券发行与交易的结算、登记及记录要求等。二、扩展代币化产品种类——把代币化政府债券发行常规化，并厘清代币化交易所买卖基金的印花税安排，推动贵金属、有色金属及可再生能源等资产的代币化。三、推进应用场景及跨界别合作——稳定币发行人发牌机制于 8 月 1 日实施。四、人才与合作伙伴发展。
summary_en: The HKSAR Government issued Policy Statement 2.0 on the Development of Digital Assets, setting out the "LEAP" framework: Legal and regulatory streamlining — a unified regulatory framework covering digital asset trading platforms, stablecoin issuers, digital asset dealing service providers and digital asset custodian service providers, with the SFC as the leading authority for the latter two licensing regimes; the FSTB and HKMA will lead a comprehensive legal review to facilitate tokenisation of real-world assets and financial instruments, examining settlement, registration and record requirements for tokenised bond issuance and transactions. Expanding the suite of tokenised products — regularising tokenised government bond issuance and clarifying stamp duty treatment for tokenised ETFs, and promoting tokenisation of precious metals, non-ferrous metals and renewable energy assets. Advancing use cases and cross-sectoral collaboration — the stablecoin issuer licensing regime takes effect on 1 August. Plus people and partnership development.

title: 美国货币监理署发布解释函 1183，确认银行可开展加密资产托管等活动
title_en: OCC Interpretive Letter 1183 reaffirms permissible crypto-asset activities for national banks
summary: 美国货币监理署（OCC）发布第 1183 号解释函，重申国民银行与联邦储蓄协会可开展加密资产托管、分布式分类账（作为独立节点验证网络参与）及特定稳定币活动，并废除此前第 1179 号解释函所要求的「监管不反对」（supervisory nonobjection）程序及事前证明具备足够管控的要求。该函同时确认第 1170、1172、1174 号解释函所涉活动属许可范围，OCC 将通过持续监管程序检查前述活动；银行仍须以安全、稳健、公平且合规的方式开展相关业务。
summary_en: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency published Interpretive Letter 1183, reaffirming that crypto-asset custody, distributed ledger (independent node verification network) participation and certain stablecoin activities are permissible for national banks and federal savings associations. The letter rescinds Interpretive Letter 1179, removing the requirement to obtain supervisory nonobjection and demonstrate adequate controls before engaging in such activities, and confirms the activities addressed in Interpretive Letters 1170, 1172 and 1174 remain permissible. The OCC will examine these activities through its ongoing supervisory process, and banks must conduct them in a safe, sound and fair manner in compliance with applicable law.

title: 欧盟 MiCA 全面适用（2024 年 12 月 30 日）：ESMA 发布最后一批技术标准与指引
title_en: MiCA becomes fully applicable on 30 December 2024: ESMA publishes its final package of technical standards and guidelines
summary: ESMA 在《加密资产市场监管条例》(MiCA) 全面适用前发布最后一批载有监管技术标准与指引的最终报告；过去 18 个月 ESMA 共完成 30 余项技术标准与指引，其中多项与 EBA 合作制定。本批内容包括：关于市场滥用的监管技术标准（防范与侦测加密资产市场滥用的系统与程序、可疑市场滥用报告模板、跨境情形下的主管机构协调程序）；关于反向招揽的指引（明确该豁免应作极窄解释、属例外而不得用于规避 MiCA 要求，仅在客户为服务的排他性发起方时适用）；适当性指引；加密资产转移服务指引；以及关于加密资产是否构成金融工具的指引（用于厘清 MiCA 与 MiFID II 等其他行业法规的适用边界）。ESMA 主席表示，MiCA 自 2024 年 12 月 30 日起适用是建立加密市场监管框架的重要一步，但新制度不足以消除加密资产市场的固有不确定性与波动，投资者应充分了解风险。
summary_en: ESMA published the last package of final reports containing regulatory technical standards and guidelines ahead of the full entry into application of the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA). Over the previous 18 months ESMA delivered more than 30 technical standards and guidelines, many developed with the EBA. The package covers: RTS on market abuse (systems and procedures to prevent and detect market abuse, the template for reporting suspected market abuse, and coordination procedures between competent authorities for cross-border cases); guidelines on reverse solicitation (confirming the exemption is very narrowly framed, an exception rather than a way to circumvent MiCA, applying only where the client is the exclusive initiator); guidelines on suitability; guidelines on crypto-asset transfer services; and guidelines on the qualification of crypto-assets as financial instruments (clarifying the boundary between MiCA and other frameworks such as MiFID II). ESMA's Chair noted that the entry into application of MiCA from 30 December 2024 marks a significant step towards a regulatory framework for crypto markets, but that the new regime would not eliminate the inherent uncertainty and volatility of the market.
sourceName: 欧洲证券和市场管理局（ESMA）官网新闻稿

title: 美国国税局发布数字资产交易经纪商报税新规
title_en: IRS Finalizes Reporting Rules for Digital Asset Brokers
summary: 美国国税局发布最终规章，要求定期促成特定数字资产买卖与兑换的经纪商，就交易毛收入及计税基础向税务机关申报并提供收款人声明。
summary_en: The IRS issued final regulations requiring brokers who regularly facilitate certain digital asset sales and exchanges to report gross proceeds and tax basis to the IRS and furnish payee statements.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港金管局推出「数码债券资助计划」，每笔合资格数码债券最高资助 250 万港元
title_en: HKMA launches the Digital Bond Grant Scheme, up to HK$2.5 million per eligible digital bond issuance
summary: 香港金融管理局推出在 2024 年《施政报告》中公布的「数码债券资助计划」（DBGS），旨在促进数码证券市场发展，并鼓励资本市场更广泛运用代币化技术。若能满足资助计划相关资格要求，每笔在香港发行的数码债券可获最高 250 万港元的资助。经咨询业界后，金管局在「数码债券资助计划」指引中胪列了资助计划的详情；资助计划即日起接受申请，初步为期三年。
summary_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched the Digital Bond Grant Scheme (DBGS), announced in the 2024 Policy Address. The DBGS aims to promote the development of the digital securities market and encourage broader adoption of tokenisation technology in capital market transactions. Subject to satisfaction of the relevant eligibility requirements, a maximum grant of HK$2.5 million will be offered to each eligible digital bond issuance in Hong Kong. Following industry consultation, the HKMA set out the details of the DBGS in the Guideline on the Digital Bond Grant Scheme. The scheme started accepting applications on the launch date, with an initial period of three years.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网新闻稿

title: 新加坡金管局公布资产代币化商业化计划（GWN / GL1 / GFIF / GFF）
title_en: MAS announces plans to commercialise asset tokenisation (GWN / GL1 / GFIF / GFF)
summary: 金管局公布推进代币化的四项举措：由花旗、汇丰、施罗德、渣打与大华组成 Guardian Wholesale Network 商业化网络；GL1 扩展至市场基建生态（控制原则、规格、合规即设计）；发布《Guardian 固定收益框架》(GFIF) 与《Guardian 基金框架》(GFF)；提供新元批发型 CBDC 测试网（SGD Testnet）作为共同结算资产。
summary_en: MAS set out four moves: the Guardian Wholesale Network formed by Citi, HSBC, Schroders, Standard Chartered and UOB; GL1 expanded to a market-infrastructure ecosystem; the Guardian Fixed Income Framework and Guardian Funds Framework published; and an SGD wholesale CBDC testnet as a common settlement asset.
sourceName: 新加坡政府新闻稿库

title: 金管局与巴西中央银行合作，连接 Ensemble 沙盒与 Drex 试点平台
title_en: HKMA partners with Banco Central do Brasil to link the Ensemble Sandbox and the Drex pilot platform
summary: 金管局宣布与巴西中央银行在 Project Ensemble 与 Drex 试点计划下开展跨境代币化实验，把双方的央行数码货币实验基建——Ensemble 沙盒与 Drex 试点平台——连接起来，探索贸易融资与碳信用等领域的跨境支付对支付（PvP）与交付对支付（DvP）结算用例。金管局于 2024 年 8 月推出 Ensemble 沙盒；巴西央行于 2024 年 9 月公布 Drex 试点第二阶段共 13 个主题。
summary_en: The HKMA announced a collaboration with Banco Central do Brasil to conduct cross-border tokenisation experiments under Project Ensemble and the Drex pilot programme, linking their experimental CBDC infrastructures — the Ensemble Sandbox and the Drex pilot platform — to explore cross-border payment-versus-payment (PvP) and delivery-versus-payment (DvP) settlement use cases in areas such as trade finance and carbon credits. The HKMA launched the Ensemble Sandbox in August 2024; the BCB announced 13 themes for the second phase of its Drex pilot in September 2024.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

title: 金管局与泰国中央银行合作，在 Ensemble 项目下探索跨境代币化用例
title_en: HKMA partners with Bank of Thailand on cross-border tokenisation under Project Ensemble
summary: 金管局宣布与泰国中央银行在 Project Ensemble 与 Project San 下合作，探索跨境代币化用例，包括贸易支付与碳信用，并以支付对支付（PvP）和交付对支付（DvP）为方向。双方将进行概念验证，测试 Project Ensemble 下分布式分类账技术金融市场基建（DLT FMI）与泰国 Project San 之间的互通性。Ensemble 沙盒于 2024 年 8 月推出，围绕固定收益与投资基金、流动性管理、绿色与可持续金融、贸易与供应链金融四大主题。
summary_en: The HKMA announced a collaboration with the Bank of Thailand to explore cross-border tokenisation use cases under Project Ensemble and Project San, including trade payments and carbon credits with payment-versus-payment (PvP) and delivery-versus-payment (DvP) settlement. A proof of concept will test interoperability between DLT-based financial market infrastructures under Project Ensemble and BOT Project San. The Ensemble Sandbox, launched in August 2024, covers four themes: fixed income and investment funds, liquidity management, green and sustainable finance, and trade and supply chain finance.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

title: 香港金管局推出 Ensemble 项目沙盒，四大代币化主题进入实测
title_en: HKMA launches Project Ensemble Sandbox with four tokenisation themes
summary: 金管局举行 Ensemble 项目沙盒启动仪式，宣布首轮实验的四大代币化资产主题：固定收益与投资基金、流动性管理、绿色及可持续金融、贸易与供应链金融。参与银行已将代币化存款平台接入沙盒，进行银行同业付款对付款（PvP）与货银两讫（DvP）结算实验；证监会为架构社群关键成员，与金管局共同牵头资产管理业代币化举措。
summary_en: The HKMA launched the Project Ensemble Sandbox with four initial themes: fixed income and investment funds, liquidity management, green and sustainable finance, and trade and supply chain finance. Participating banks connected tokenised deposit platforms for PvP and DvP settlement experiments.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

title: 美国国税局更正数字资产交易报税规章文本
title_en: IRS Corrects Textual Errors in Digital Asset Reporting Rule
summary: 美国国税局发布更正公告，修正7月9日公布的TD 10000号最终规章中关于数字资产交易毛收入与计税基础申报及实现金额确定的相关文字错误。
summary_en: The IRS issued a correction notice amending typographical and textual errors in TD 10000, its July 9 final rule on reporting gross proceeds, tax basis, and realized amounts for digital asset transactions.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 美国国税局明确数字资产交易毛收入与计税基础申报规则
title_en: IRS Clarifies Gross Proceeds and Adjusted Basis Reporting for Digital Assets
summary: 美国国税局发布最终规章，规定经纪商须就特定数字资产买卖与兑换交易，申报毛收入及调整后计税基础，并向收款人提供相应声明。
summary_en: The IRS finalized regulations mandating brokers to report gross proceeds and adjusted tax basis for specified digital asset sales and exchanges, and to furnish corresponding payee statements.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

title: 香港金管局启动 Ensemble 项目（批发层面央行数码货币 wCBDC）
title_en: HKMA launches Project Ensemble (wholesale CBDC) to support tokenisation
summary: 金管局宣布展开批发层面央行数码货币（wCBDC）项目 Ensemble，以支持香港代币化市场发展：初期聚焦代币化存款，并推出 wCBDC 沙盒研究代币化现实世界资产交收（绿色债券、自愿减排量、飞机、电动汽车充电站、电子提单及财资管理），同时成立 wCBDC 架构工作小组。
summary_en: The HKMA launched Project Ensemble, a wCBDC project to support Hong Kong tokenisation: initially focused on tokenised deposits, with a wCBDC sandbox testing settlement of tokenised real-world assets (green bonds, carbon credits, aircraft, EV charging stations, eBL, treasury management).
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

title: 香港特区政府发售第二批数码绿色债券（全球首批多币种数码原生债券）
title_en: HKSAR Government offers second digital green bond issue (world-first multi-currency digital native bond)
summary: 香港特区政府在政府绿色债券计划下成功发售总值约 60 亿港元、以港元、人民币、美元及欧元计价的二年期数码绿色债券，为全球首批多币种数码债券，亦是首批在香港发行的数码原生债券；采用 HSBC Orion 为数码资产平台、金管局 CMU 结算并通过与 Euroclear / Clearstream 的联接扩大投资者参与，并首次采用 ICMA 债券数据分类标准（BDT）。
summary_en: The HKSAR Government successfully offered around HK$6 billion of two-year digital green bonds denominated in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR — the world's first multi-currency digital bond and the first digitally native bond issued in Hong Kong. HSBC Orion served as the digital asset platform, settlement via the HKMA CMU with Euroclear/Clearstream linkages, and ICMA Bond Data Taxonomy adopted for the first time.
sourceName: 香港金管局官网

title: 新加坡金管局扩大资产代币化试点并推出 Global Layer One
title_en: MAS expands asset tokenisation pilots and launches Global Layer One
summary: 金管局宣布在 Project Guardian 下与 17 家金融机构新增 5 个业界试点（做市报价、跨境外汇支付、财资管理、代币化货币市场基金、另类资产组合管理），新增基金工作流推动 VCC 基金原生发行，并推出 Global Layer One（GL1）数字基建倡议与《Interlinking Networks》白皮书。
summary_en: MAS announced five new industry pilots under Project Guardian with 17 financial institutions, a new funds workstream for native VCC fund issuance, the Global Layer One (GL1) digital infrastructure initiative and the "Interlinking Networks" whitepaper.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网

title: 香港证监会发出《有关代币化证监会认可投资产品的通函》（23EC53）
title_en: SFC circular on tokenisation of SFC-authorised investment products (23EC53)
summary: 证监会就代币化证监会认可投资产品发出通函，说明在《证券及期货条例》第 IV 部下获认可投资产品进行代币化并向香港公众发售的条件。证监会采取「透视」方式，认为只要底层产品符合所有适用的产品认可规定并满足针对代币化安排的额外保障措施，即可允许一级市场交易（认购与赎回）；二级市场交易则需更审慎处理。产品提供者须对代币化安排的运作稳健性及持有人所有权记录负最终责任（即使外包亦然），须采取网络安全、数据私隐、系统中断与恢复等措施，未经附加适当管控不得使用公有无许可区块链，并须按证监会要求提供第三方审计或验证及法律意见；发售文件须清楚披露代币化安排、代币的所有权代表方式及相关风险（包括链下或链上结算是否终局）。
summary_en: The SFC issued a circular setting out the requirements under which it would consider allowing tokenisation of investment products authorised under Part IV of the Securities and Futures Ordinance for offering to the public in Hong Kong. Adopting a see-through approach, the SFC considers it appropriate to allow primary dealing (subscription and redemption) provided the underlying product meets all applicable authorisation requirements plus additional safeguards; secondary trading warrants more caution. Product providers remain ultimately responsible for the soundness of the tokenisation arrangement and ownership records even where outsourced, must manage cybersecurity, data privacy, system outage and recovery risks, should not use public-permissionless blockchain networks without additional proper controls, and must obtain third-party audit or verification and satisfactory legal opinion upon request. Offering documents must clearly disclose the tokenisation arrangement (including whether off-chain or on-chain settlement is final), the ownership representation of the tokens and associated risks.
sourceName: 香港证监会官网（通函）

title: 香港证监会发出《有关中介人从事代币化证券相关活动的通函》（23EC52）
title_en: SFC circular on intermediaries engaging in tokenised securities-related activities (23EC52)
summary: 证监会向中介人发出通函，就从事代币化证券相关活动提供监管指引。通函说明：代币化证券指属《证券及期货条例》附表 1 第 1 部所界定「证券」的传统金融工具（例如债券或基金），而其证券生命周期中使用了分布式分类账技术（DLT）或类似技术；代币化可带来提升效率、增加透明度、缩短交收时间及降低成本等潜在好处，同时产生拥有权风险与科技风险等新风险。证监会表示支持中介人将传统证券代币化，并厘清其应达致的监管要求；就证监会认可投资产品而言，本通函应与其代币化相关通函一并阅读。
summary_en: The SFC issued a circular providing guidance to intermediaries engaging in tokenised securities-related activities. It defines tokenised securities as traditional financial instruments (e.g. bonds or funds) that fall within the definition of "securities" under the Securities and Futures Ordinance, whose securities lifecycle uses distributed ledger technology (DLT) or similar technology. The circular notes potential benefits — efficiency, transparency, shorter settlement times and lower costs — alongside new ownership and technology risks, and clarifies the regulatory expectations for intermediaries. It is to be read together with the SFC circular on tokenisation of SFC-authorised investment products.
sourceName: 香港证监会官网（通函）

title: 新加坡金管局敲定稳定币监管框架（单一货币稳定币）
title_en: MAS finalises Stablecoin Regulatory Framework for single-currency stablecoins
summary: 新加坡金融管理局公布稳定币监管框架的最终设计，适用于在新加坡发行、锚定新元或十国集团（G10）任一货币的单一货币稳定币（SCS）。框架核心要求包括：储备资产须按面值 100% 支持流通中的稳定币并实施储备管理要求、发行人须维持基础资本、持有人须可在提出赎回要求后 5 个工作日内按面值赎回、以及定期披露与审计要求；符合全部要求的发行人可向金管局申请使用「MAS-regulated stablecoin」（受金管局监管稳定币）标签，以区别于其他稳定币。
summary_en: MAS set out the final design of its Stablecoin Regulatory Framework, applying to single-currency stablecoins (SCS) issued in Singapore and pegged to the Singapore dollar or any G10 currency. Key requirements include full backing of the stablecoin in circulation by reserve assets with prescribed reserve management standards, base capital requirements, redemption at par within five business days of a redemption request, and disclosure and audit requirements. Issuers meeting all requirements may apply to MAS to use the "MAS-regulated stablecoin" label to distinguish their tokens from others.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网

title: 金融稳定理事会发布《加密资产活动与市场监管、监督高级建议》最终报告（九项建议）
title_en: FSB publishes final high-level recommendations for the regulation, supervision and oversight of crypto-asset activities and markets
summary: 金融稳定理事会（FSB）发布加密资产活动与市场监管、监督的高级建议最终报告。建议面向各法域的金融监管与监督机构，目标是建立一套全球监管基线：建议应技术中立、聚焦底层活动与风险，并遵循"相同活动、相同风险、相同监管"原则；部分法域可选择采取更严格的措施。九项建议涵盖：监管权力与工具；按功能基础、与金融稳定风险相称的全面监管（含加密资产发行人与服务提供商）；跨境合作、协调与信息共享；治理；风险管理；数据收集、记录与报告；披露；识别并处置加密资产生态系统内部及其与传统金融体系之间互联互依所产生的金融稳定风险；以及对多功能加密资产服务提供商的综合监管（含利益冲突与业务隔离）。报告同时说明其聚焦金融稳定相关的监管议题，并不全面覆盖反洗钱／反恐融资、数据隐私、网络安全、消费者与投资者保护、市场诚信、竞争政策、税收、货币政策与货币主权等其他风险类别。
summary_en: The Financial Stability Board published its final high-level recommendations for the regulation, supervision and oversight of crypto-asset activities and markets. Addressed to authorities at jurisdictional level, the recommendations establish a global regulatory baseline: they are technology-neutral, focus on underlying activities and risks, and follow the principle "same activity, same risk, same regulation", with some jurisdictions free to take more restrictive measures. The nine recommendations cover: regulatory powers and tools; comprehensive and effective regulation, supervision and oversight on a functional basis proportionate to financial stability risk (including crypto-asset issuers and service providers); cross-border cooperation, coordination and information sharing; governance; risk management; data collection, recording and reporting; disclosure; identifying and addressing financial stability risks from interconnections within the crypto ecosystem and with the wider financial system; and comprehensive regulation of crypto-asset service providers combining multiple functions (including conflicts of interest and separation of functions). The FSB notes the recommendations focus on regulatory, supervisory and oversight issues relating to financial stability and do not comprehensively address other risk categories such as AML/CFT, data privacy, cyber security, consumer and investor protection, market integrity, competition, taxation, monetary policy or monetary sovereignty.
sourceName: 金融稳定理事会（FSB）官网最终报告

title: 欧盟《加密资产市场监管条例》(MiCA) 生效
title_en: EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) enters into force
summary: 《市场加密资产条例》(EU) 2023/1114 于 2023 年 6 月 9 日刊登于欧盟官方公报，2023 年 6 月 29 日生效；关于资产参考代币（ART）与电子货币代币（EMT）的第三编与第四编自 2024 年 6 月 30 日起适用，其余条款自 2024 年 12 月 30 日起全面适用，为欧盟建立统一的加密资产发行与服务提供者监管框架。
summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (MiCA) was published in the Official Journal on 9 June 2023 and entered into force on 29 June 2023. Titles III and IV on asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens apply from 30 June 2024, with full application from 30 December 2024.
sourceName: 欧盟委员会官网

title: 香港证监会通函：虚拟资产交易平台全新发牌制度 2023 年 6 月 1 日生效（双重牌照安排）
title_en: SFC circular: new licensing regime for virtual asset trading platforms takes effect on 1 June 2023 (dual licence arrangement)
summary: 《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》（第 615 章）下专为中央虚拟资产交易平台而设的全新发牌制度将于 2023 年 6 月 1 日生效。在新制度下，于香港营运的中央虚拟资产交易平台须根据《证券及期货条例》（第 571 章）及／或《打击洗钱条例》向证监会申领牌照（双重牌照安排）。证监会随通函刊发《适用于虚拟资产交易平台营运者的指引》、《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集指引（适用于持牌法团及获证监会发牌的虚拟资产服务提供者）》、《适用于虚拟资产交易平台营运者的发牌手册》及常见问题，并列明适用于持牌虚拟资产交易平台的持续通知规定；自 2023 年 6 月 1 日起，申请人可透过 WINGS（WINGS-LIC）提交申请表、补充文件与问卷。
summary_en: The new licensing regime for centralised virtual asset trading platforms under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615) will come into effect on 1 June 2023. Under the new regime, centralised virtual asset trading platforms operating in Hong Kong will need to apply to the SFC for a licence under the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) and/or the AMLO (Dual Licence Arrangement). The SFC also issued the Guidelines for Virtual Asset Trading Platform Operators, the Guideline on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (for licensed corporations and SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers), the Licensing Handbook for Virtual Asset Trading Platform Operators and FAQs, and set out ongoing notification requirements. From 1 June 2023, applicants may submit application forms, supplements and questionnaires through WINGS (WINGS-LIC).
sourceName: 香港证监会官网通函（23EC28）

title: 欧盟 DLT 市场基础设施试点制度（Regulation (EU) 2022/858）开始适用
title_en: EU DLT Pilot Regime (Regulation (EU) 2022/858) becomes applicable
summary: 欧盟《关于分布式分类账技术市场基础设施试点制度的条例》(EU) 2022/858 自 2023 年 3 月 23 日起适用，为以分布式分类账技术（DLT）运作的市场基础设施提供临时性试点框架。该制度允许合资格实体在豁免或修改部分现行欧盟金融法规的条件下，营运 DLT 多边交易设施（DLT MTF）、DLT 证券结算系统（DLT SS）及兼具交易与结算功能的 DLT 交易与结算系统（DLT TSS），用以在受监管环境中试验代币化证券的交易与结算。欧洲证券及市场管理局（ESMA）负责该制度下的相关协调与监管工作。
summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2022/858 on a pilot regime for market infrastructures based on distributed ledger technology (DLT) applies from 23 March 2023. It provides a temporary pilot framework allowing eligible entities to operate DLT multilateral trading facilities (DLT MTFs), DLT securities settlement systems (DLT SSs) and combined DLT trading and settlement systems (DLT TSSs) under exemptions from, or modifications to, certain EU financial services rules, so that trading and settlement of tokenised securities can be tested in a regulated environment. ESMA is responsible for related coordination and supervision under the regime.
sourceName: 欧洲证券及市场管理局官网

title: 香港特区政府发售首批代币化绿色债券（全球首批政府代币化债券）
title_en: HKSAR Government prices inaugural tokenised green bond (world first by a government)
summary: 香港特区政府在政府绿色债券计划下成功发售 8 亿港元一年期代币化绿色债券，收益率 4.05%，为全球首批由政府发行的代币化绿色债券。由四间银行承销，金管局债务工具中央结算系统（CMU）结算交收，采用高盛代币化平台 GS DAP，一级发行以 T+1 货银两讫（DvP）方式在私有区块链网络上结算。
summary_en: The HKSAR Government priced HK$800m of one-year tokenised green bonds at a 4.05% yield under its Green Bond Programme — the first tokenised green bond issued by a government globally. Cleared through the HKMA CMU on Goldman Sachs GS DAP with T+1 DvP settlement.
sourceName: 香港政府绿色债券计划官网

title: 香港特区政府发表《有关虚拟资产在港发展的政策宣言》
title_en: Hong Kong issues Policy Statement on Development of Virtual Assets
summary: 香港特区政府发表虚拟资产政策宣言，阐明政策立场：对全球虚拟资产创新者持开放兼融态度；正加紧筹备虚拟资产服务提供者发牌制度，证监会将就零售投资者可买卖虚拟资产的适当程度展开公众咨询，政府对引入虚拟资产 ETF 持欢迎态度；对日后检讨代币化资产的产权与智能合约合法性持开放态度；金管局将就稳定币监管制度发布咨询结果。试验计划包括 2022 年金融科技周 NFT 发行、绿色债券代币化及数码港元。
summary_en: The HKSAR Government issued a policy statement: open and inclusive towards global VA innovators; preparing a licensing regime for VA service providers; SFC to consult on retail access; open to VA ETFs; open to reviewing property rights of tokenised assets and legality of smart contracts; HKMA to announce stablecoin consultation outcome. Pilots include NFT issuance for Fintech Week 2022, green bond tokenisation and e-HKD.
sourceName: 香港政府新闻公报

title: 新加坡金管局启动 Project Guardian，联合业界试点资产代币化
title_en: MAS launches Project Guardian to pilot asset tokenisation with the industry
summary: 新加坡金融管理局宣布启动 Project Guardian，与金融业界合作探索资产代币化的经济潜力与用例，四大方向为开放互操作网络、信任锚、资产代币化、机构级 DeFi 协议；首个业界试点由星展银行、摩根大通与 Marketnode 主导，在许可流动性池中开展代币化债券与存款的担保借贷。
summary_en: MAS launched Project Guardian to explore asset tokenisation across four areas: open interoperable networks, trust anchors, asset tokenisation and institutional-grade DeFi protocols. The first pilot, led by DBS, J.P. Morgan and Marketnode, tested secured borrowing and lending of tokenised bonds and deposits.
sourceName: 新加坡金管局官网

authority: 中国人民银行等十部门
title: 中国人民银行等十部门发布《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）
title_en: PBOC and nine other agencies issue the 2021 notice on preventing and disposing of virtual currency trading speculation risks (Yin Fa [2021] No. 237)
summary: 中国人民银行、中央网信办、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院、工业和信息化部、公安部、市场监管总局、银保监会、证监会、外汇局联合发布通知（落款 2021 年 9 月 15 日）。核心内容：①虚拟货币不具有与法定货币等同的法律地位，不具有法偿性，不应且不能作为货币在市场上流通使用；②虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动——包括法定货币与虚拟货币兑换、虚拟货币之间兑换、作为中央对手方买卖虚拟货币、为虚拟货币交易提供信息中介和定价服务、代币发行融资以及虚拟货币衍生品交易等，一律严格禁止、坚决依法取缔；③境外虚拟货币交易所通过互联网向境内居民提供服务同样属于非法金融活动；④金融机构和非银行支付机构不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供服务；⑤企业、个体工商户注册名称和经营范围中不得含有"虚拟货币""虚拟资产""加密货币""加密资产"等字样或内容；⑥参与虚拟货币投资交易活动存在法律风险，违背公序良俗的相关民事法律行为无效，由此引发的损失由其自行承担。
summary_en: The People's Bank of China, together with nine other agencies, issued a notice dated 15 September 2021. Its core provisions: (1) virtual currencies do not have the same legal status as legal tender and are not legal tender, and should not and cannot circulate as currency in the market; (2) virtual currency-related business activities are illegal financial activities — including exchange between legal tender and virtual currencies, exchanges among virtual currencies, buying or selling virtual currencies as a central counterparty, providing information intermediary and pricing services for virtual currency trading, token issuance and financing, and virtual currency derivatives trading — all strictly prohibited and resolutely banned according to law; (3) overseas virtual currency exchanges providing services to mainland residents via the internet are likewise engaged in illegal financial activities; (4) financial institutions and non-bank payment institutions may not provide services for virtual currency-related business activities; (5) the registered names and business scopes of enterprises and individually-owned businesses may not contain terms such as "virtual currency", "virtual asset", "crypto currency" or "crypto asset"; and (6) participating in virtual currency investment and trading carries legal risk, and relevant civil juristic acts contrary to public order and good morals are void, with the resulting losses borne by the parties themselves.
sourceName: 中国政府网政策文件库

title: 瑞士《分布式电子登记技术联邦法适应性修订法》（DLT 法）全面生效
title_en: Switzerland brings the DLT Act fully into force
summary: 瑞士联邦委员会于 2021 年 6 月 18 日决定自 2021 年 8 月 1 日起全面实施《联邦法律适应分布式电子登记技术发展的联邦法》（DLT 法）及其配套总括条例。该法修订《债务法典》《中介证券法》及《国际私法》等，引入以区块链登记的登记式证券（ledger-based securities），使证券可在区块链上发行；明确破产情形下加密资产的分离处理，并设立 DLT 交易设施这一新牌照类别。瑞士因此成为全球最早为区块链技术建立成文法规则的国家之一，为代币化资产的发行与交易场所发牌提供法律确定性。
summary_en: On 18 June 2021 the Swiss Federal Council decided to bring the Federal Act on the Adaptation of Federal Law to Developments in Distributed Electronic Register Technology (DLT Act) and the associated blanket ordinance fully into force as of 1 August 2021. The Act amends the Code of Obligations, the Federal Intermediated Securities Act and the Federal Act on International Private Law, introducing ledger-based securities represented on a blockchain so that securities can be issued on-chain, clarifying the segregation of crypto-based assets in bankruptcy, and creating a new licence category for DLT trading facilities. Switzerland became one of the first countries to enact statutory rules for blockchain technology, providing legal certainty for tokenised assets and for licensing trading venues.
sourceName: 瑞士联邦国际金融事务秘书处（SIF）官网

authority: 中国人民银行等七部委
title: 中国人民银行等七部委发布《关于防范代币发行融资风险的公告》，各类代币发行融资活动立即停止
title_en: PBOC and six other agencies announce the ban on token issuance and financing (ICO)
summary: 中国人民银行、中央网信办、工业和信息化部、工商总局、银监会、证监会、保监会联合发布公告，认定代币发行融资（含 ICO）本质上是未经批准非法公开融资的行为，涉嫌非法发售代币票券、非法发行证券、非法集资、金融诈骗、传销等违法犯罪活动。公告要求：自发布之日起各类代币发行融资活动应当立即停止，已完成的应当做出清退等安排；任何所谓的代币融资交易平台不得从事法定货币与代币、"虚拟货币"相互之间的兑换业务，不得买卖或作为中央对手方买卖代币或"虚拟货币"，不得为其提供定价、信息中介等服务；各金融机构和非银行支付机构不得直接或间接为代币发行融资和"虚拟货币"提供账户开立、登记、交易、清算、结算等产品或服务。公告同时明确：代币或"虚拟货币"不由货币当局发行，不具有法偿性与强制性等货币属性，不具有与货币等同的法律地位，不能也不应作为货币在市场上流通使用。
summary_en: The People's Bank of China, jointly with six other agencies, issued an announcement finding that token issuance and financing (including ICOs) is in essence an unapproved illegal public fundraising activity, potentially involving illegal issuance of token tickets or securities, illegal fundraising, financial fraud and pyramid schemes. The announcement requires that all token issuance and financing activities cease immediately from the date of publication, with completed ones making refund arrangements; that no so-called token financing trading platform may engage in exchange between legal tender and tokens or "virtual currencies", may not buy or sell or act as central counterparty in tokens or "virtual currencies", and may not provide pricing or information intermediary services for them; and that financial institutions and non-bank payment institutions may not directly or indirectly provide account opening, registration, trading, clearing or settlement products or services for token issuance and financing or "virtual currencies". It also states that tokens or "virtual currencies" are not issued by the monetary authority, do not have legal tender status or mandatory currency attributes, do not have the same legal status as currency, and cannot and should not circulate as currency in the market.
sourceName: 国家金融监督管理总局（原银监会）官网公告全文
